GDD 8.2 CELL BY CELL (what the build does):
- Hajjiya. Hand: holds dead straight for 5.99 s (719 ticks) against the crown and a pulling steering; 0.000 to 0.025 m off the line in gears 1 to 4, from rest, braking to a halt, in neutral, with bull bar, spinner knob, rain, Nerves 95, the wheel at 90 degrees when asked; a bend, a gust and Courage's sway carry the car off as D-051 says; with the hook set she takes the wheel from it and the hook cools down as usual (p12). Weight: +10.00 for cig_light and flask_sip only; tea, energy drink, seeds, beads, painkillers, mints +0.00; the Thermos is out of reach; prayer +3.00/s in gears 4 and 5, 0 in gears 0 to 3 (p20). Rides: 3 stalls, stopped at or not; out at the stop after a boss when the third stall was driven past (p14, tests). Fare: -20 (clamped at 0), blessing kept through two saves; the charm's scrape comes first, a crash does not spend it, a barrier at the Checkpoint is spared its lamp but not its 25 Suspicion (p22, p04).
- Conscript. Hand: gain_mult 0.50 (0.25 with tinted glass), rates and one-offs, at the Checkpoint too, asleep or awake; the cigarette burns with an empty pack, needs ashing, starts a craving, no second while one burns (p11). Weight: snore -0.5/s only asleep; tap, horn TAP and the keypad's horn key wake him for 20 s, also while a phone or the Call rings; a Snap's horn does not (finding RULES-09). Rides and fare: out at the stop after the boss with 10, also after being turned back (p14).
- Drummer. Hand: music status and -0.50/s, Awake; the tea's anchor moves to (0.24, 0.10, 0.04) for cup_a or cup_b, only the tea's; he can still take the rim beside it (102 px away). Weight: 20.00 Suspicion in 2 s of drumming (10.00 with tinted glass), none silent, none at the Checkpoint; pulled over after exactly 10.0 s of a Patrol (p16, p20, p14). Rides: guest at the Arrival.
- Student. Hand: every call answered in the tick it rings, also in a Snap, no Suspicion, none at a stop; Noor's call is left to him; Awake below the floor all leg; sign 139 m earlier (but see RULES-06). Weight: +5.00 per scrape, spared or not; gear 4 in rain by the test. Rides and fare by the test and p14.
- Apprentice. Hand: one repair per leg on the road, renewed at a boss; not across a stop (RULES-02); the hold (RULES-03). Weight: lean and lever by the test; retune every 30 s (RULES-01); a tape in the deck plays on at -1.00/s.

GDD 8.1 SENTENCE BY SENTENCE: one passenger, the seat, the back seat and its return, the hook usable on the ring (p15, p12); hitchers at Hitcher stops, fuel stations and tea stalls, with the tray and the shady guy at the same stop, the door TAP with a bought thing waiting, a carried thing let go over the door (nobody boards), a seat item bought before and after boarding, refund on leaving (p15, p23); not at the stop after a boss (RULES-04); carried to Basra: guest named for the Drummer and the Apprentice, for the Hajjiya and Student only when boarded on Act 3's third leg, '' with nobody (p14); the Call handed to each of the five in each state they can be in: taken=passenger, steering normal (29.1 degrees per 100 px), no reach, 30 s (p13).

OTHER SEAMS FOUND SOUND: two saves and loads in a row with each passenger (who rides, legs, drumming or silent, blessed, statuses, Suspicion's multiplier, the phone answered, the tea's place, the Thermos behind the seat are kept; awake, hold and repair-in-progress end at a stop as D-051 says; only `repaired` is lost, RULES-02) (p04, p05); a Wreck with each aboard: the Telling is told again with an empty seat and nothing left over (p19); at a stop no Hand, no Weight, no timer for any of the five (p23); replay: five input-only sessions over a stop where a hitcher boards and is asked on the next leg replay to the same state hash, also from the log's bytes, with all 27 to 38 intermediate hashes equal (p08); soaks: 15 random-hand sessions (p26) and 9 whole Tellings with the stand-in at the wheel, hitchers let in, bosses and Arrival included (p27): no engine error, no event outside EventNames.ALL, no line id missing from either line file, no impossible passenger state. No passenger number lives in code: passenger_sim.gd holds only zeros, half-tick roundings and string offsets; the rest is passengers.json and tuning (radio_music_rate, hitcher_chance, fork_sign_lead).

NOT APPLICABLE: the Hajjiya asked while he grips, and the drum toggled during a sip (the tap needs the same hand); the tea stowed (the tea glass has no stow ritual); her 'forbids' against a handed cigarette (they cannot meet; note that light_handed() does not go through used_tags, so the tag logic would not see one).

COULD NOT CHECK / UNVERIFIED: that the drum covers 10% of the view (seen only in artifacts/m8_drummer_tea.png, about the right 11% of the frame; view_block_right itself only switches the prop on); a search and the papers done by hand with a passenger aboard (driven by the stand-in bot; _turn_back called directly); Tables 6 and 7 and the guests' heckles (M9, not built); audio; touch.

OBSERVATIONS, NOT COUNTED AS FINDINGS: (1) Under D-051 the Conscript always gets out at the stop after a boss, Dawn's included, so he can never be a wedding guest (matters for M9's guests). (2) Student + phone + taxi sign earn +330 cash in 300 s with no hand (GDD's own numbers; balance, M11). (3) In pointer space passenger_shoulder is 29 px from offer_5 (snap radius 60): at a stop with five offers and somebody in the seat a TAP meant for the fifth offer can land on the shoulder, where it does nothing; this goes away once D-049's 'cabin rituals are not offered at a stop' is built. The held-out tea sits 41 px from the radio and 45 px from the hazard button (p24, p25). (4) The 30 s to the next retune start again at every stop (not in the save). (5) hand.on is validated and never read. (6) No passenger_left is announced at a Wreck.
